5237.html:
5237 jīrṇá 'old, worn-out' AV., 'digested' MBh. [~ *jhīrṇa-. — √jr̥̄¹]
    Pa. jiṇṇa-, °aka- 'decayed, decrepit, frail'; Pk. jiṇṇa- 'old, worn-out, digested'; Ku. jino 'old, shrivelled, stiff', jiniṇo 'to become shrivelled'; A. zīn 'worn-out, digested'; B. jīna 'old, worn-out'; Or. jīna 'very old, dilapidated'; H. jīn 'old', m. 'old man'; OSi. jiṇa 'decayed', Si. duṇu (< jiṇ + ū < bhūtá-).
    jīrṇavastra-.
